name: TOTP Sign-In Rejected
summary: Rejects an invalid, expired, or replayed TOTP proof without establishing an authenticated session and directs the user to the dedicated unable-to-authenticate surface.

guards.expression: the identified account has TOTP enabled and the submitted code is not accepted

sourceReferences.note: VerifyTotpAsync rejects missing, malformed, mismatched, or replayed TOTP proofs without establishing a session.
Rejected TOTP sign-in is a materially distinct public outcome and lands on a dedicated unable-to-authenticate view offering Try Again and Start Over.
